topic: How are link budgets affected when prioritizing high-revenue services versus navigation safety margins in dynamic scheduling?
consensus_response: The link budget design choices, influenced by array factors and interference, dictate the margins needed.  Higher array factors and narrower beamwidths increase interference, necessitating higher margins to maintain performance.  Lower margins for safety margins ensure navigation integrity, potentially impacting performance negatively. This trade-off highlights the need for a balanced approach to maximize revenue service throughput while maintaining safety margins for reliable navigation.  This dynamic process must be carefully managed to achieve optimal network performance.
